schema.text: What kind of crossing or passage is this?
schema.help: A passage is any way to get across a road, a railway or a difference in level.

options.text: A street crossing (zebra crossing or intersection)
A bridge or footbridge over the road
An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a few steps between two levels (a longer stairway is assessed as a street segment)

en.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: What kind of crossing or passage is this?
en.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: A passage is any way to get across a road, a railway or a difference in level.
en.#A street crossing (zebra crossing or in: A street crossing (zebra crossing or intersection)
en.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: A bridge or footbridge over the road
en.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a few steps between two levels (a longer stairway is assessed as a street segment)

it.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: Che tipo di attraversamento o passaggio è?
it.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: Per passaggio si intende qualsiasi modo per superare una strada, una ferrovia o un dislivello.
it.#A street crossing (zebra crossing or in: Attraversamento della strada (strisce pedonali o incrocio)
it.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: Ponte o passerella sopra la strada
it.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: Ascensore, scala mobile, rampa o pochi gradini tra due livelli (una scalinata si valuta come tratto di strada)

fr.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: De quel type de traversée ou de passage s'agit-il ?
fr.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: Un passage désigne tout moyen de franchir une route, une voie ferrée ou une différence de niveau.
fr.#A street crossing (zebra crossing or in: Une traversée de rue (passage piéton ou carrefour)
fr.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: Un pont ou une passerelle au-dessus de la route
fr.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: Un ascenseur, un escalator, une rampe ou quelques marches entre deux niveaux (un long escalier s’évalue comme un tronçon de rue)

de.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: Um welche Art von Übergang oder Durchgang handelt es sich?
de.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: Ein Durchgang ist jede Möglichkeit, eine Straße, eine Bahnlinie oder einen Höhenunterschied zu überwinden.
de.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: Eine Brücke oder Fußgängerbrücke über die Straße
de.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: Aufzug, Rolltreppe, Rampe oder wenige Stufen zwischen zwei Ebenen (eine längere Treppe wird als Straßenabschnitt bewertet)

tr.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: Bu ne tür bir karşıya geçiş noktası veya geçit?
tr.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: Geçit, bir yolu, demiryolunu veya kot farkını aşmanın her türlü yoludur.
tr.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: Yolun üzerinden geçen köprü veya yaya köprüsü
tr.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: İki seviye arasında asansör, yürüyen merdiven, rampa veya birkaç basamak (uzun bir merdivenli yol sokak kesimi olarak değerlendirilir)

fa.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: این چه نوع گذرگاه یا معبری است؟
fa.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: گذرگاه هر راهی برای عبور از خیابان، راه‌آهن یا اختلاف ارتفاع است.
fa.#A street crossing (zebra crossing or in: گذرگاه عرض خیابان (خط عابر پیاده یا تقاطع)
fa.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: پل یا پل عابر پیاده روی خیابان
fa.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: آسانسور، پله برقی، رمپ یا چند پله میان دو سطح (پلکان طولانی به‌عنوان بخشی از خیابان ارزیابی می‌شود)

hu.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: Milyen átkelőről vagy átjáróról van szó?
hu.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: Átjáró minden olyan megoldás, amellyel át lehet jutni egy úton, vasúton vagy szintkülönbségen.
hu.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: Híd vagy gyalogos felüljáró az út felett
hu.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: Lift, mozgólépcső, rámpa vagy néhány lépcsőfok két szint között (a hosszabb lépcsősort utcaszakaszként kell értékelni)

ar.#What kind of crossing or passage is thi: ما نوع هذا المعبر أو الممر؟
ar.#A passage is any way to get across a ro: الممر هو أي طريقة لعبور طريق أو سكة حديد أو فرق في المستوى.
ar.#A bridge or footbridge over the road: جسر أو جسر مشاة فوق الطريق
ar.#An elevator, an escalator, a ramp or a: مصعد أو سلم متحرك أو منحدر أو بضع درجات بين مستويين (الدرج الطويل يُقيَّم كمقطع من الشارع)
